summary: Test suite structure is sound (3 well-organized files with clear roles), but CRITICAL test fixtures and supporting files are missing: fixtures/*.txt files, rules.conf, and .github/workflows/pr-label-assigner.yml are all referenced but not provided—making the suite unrunnable. Workflow structure tests are reasonable but shallow. Label assigner tests cover basic happy-path (docs/api/tests labels, dedup, priority ordering) but lack edge-case rigor: no tests for malformed priorities, special characters, empty inputs, glob edge cases (nested patterns, ** behavior), or complex priority conflicts. act_result.bats adds circular dependency on external artifact. Cannot trust this suite to catch regressions without fixtures and substantial edge-case expansion.
